response.overview: The product of years of reflection on childhood and birthplace. It is an effort to create a document of memory tied to place. I shot the first rounds of images on photochemical film to make a physical light record. That then shifted to home development using foraged material from the creek and surrounding yard to further try to capture physical memory of some sort. These records and memories then became subtexts in a larger, more abstract digital rendering.  The film Utilizes Super 8 sequences shot 60 years apart & the audio comes from a rock cap fern hooked up to a 4-track cassette recorder and distorted. Some of the images were developed in a creek water and wild onion developer. The developer materials and fern were foraged on location in Western Pennsylvania.
response.title: Your Tongue is Black
